fields.value: UNDPOLAR survey on threats, identities, and political polarization
Survey in 9 European countries on threats, identities, and political attitudes

dsDescriptionValue.value: This survey in nine European countries was intended to investigate the relations between threats, identities, and political polarisation. Data was collected using online surveys. In each country there was a quota sample (N=1200) with quota for age, education, gender, and region. Data was collected by the UNDPOLAR consortium, funded by the NORFACE-Governance programme.
